name: Yuujirou
source: Former police dog apprentice of the Fujimi house. He became useless due to his pervertedness: whenever he would see a woman, Yuujirou would start relentlessly shake his hips. Due to its furry fur, Yuujirou can hide all sorts of items in its body.
